title: derris piscatoria
intro: Derris piscatoria, commonly known as Tinospora crispa, is a type of plant that belongs to the Menispermaceae family. It is a climbing plant native to Southeast Asia and is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The health benefits of Derris piscatoria include its ability to aid in digestion, lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-diarrheal, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
